name: startup-errors
//: Issue #39: a start that fails or hangs says where and why (the card, the diagnostics button's title, the download's message, Copy debug info), never a spinner for ever. Each start fails as asked (content-main.ts testFailure, the mock's zipmode), then the last one opens.

steps.until: __phitexBoot().then((b) => b.stage === 'Starting the engine… (its page loaded, waiting for it to answer)')

steps.what: the engine's page never answering: the step said on the diagnostics button's title, not "starting…"
steps.check: document.getElementById('phitex-logs').title === 'PhiTeX diagnostics · Starting the engine… (its page loaded, waiting for it to answer)'

steps.what: the PDF downloaded: not "the build stopped", there was none; where the start is
steps.check: (() => { document.getElementById('phitex-status').click(); const t = document.querySelector('phitex-preview').shadowRoot.querySelector('#m-time .msg')?.textContent ?? ''; document.getElementById('phitex-status').click(); return t === 'No PDF yet: no build has run. ⚡ Instant is at "Starting the engine… (its page loaded, waiting for it to answer)".' || t; })()

steps.what: Copy debug info, the engine's page never answering: reached from the status text, copied; the step, the version, the browser, the isolation
has: ^ +[0-9.]+ s Starting the engine… \(its page loaded, waiting for it to answer\)$

steps.what: and from the diagnostics button, no dead end
the engine's modules failing to load: said
steps.check: document.querySelector('phitex-preview').shadowRoot.querySelector('#empty .card').textContent.includes("Starting the engine (its page loaded, waiting for it to answer) failed: the engine didn't start: a test: the engine's modules failed to load")

steps.what: the core's worker script not fetched: said
steps.check: document.querySelector('phitex-preview').shadowRoot.querySelector('#empty .card').textContent.includes("Starting the engine (its page loaded, waiting for it to answer) failed: the engine didn't start: fetching the core's worker script (dist/engine-worker.js): ")

steps.what: Report this on the card: a GitHub issue and an email, drafted with the debug info (the step and the error), well formed
steps.check: (() => { const r = document.querySelector('phitex-preview').shadowRoot.querySelector('#empty .card .phx-report'); if (!r) return 'no Report this'; const i = new URL(r.querySelector('a.phx-report-issue').href), m = r.querySelector('a.phx-report-mail').href; const q = new URLSearchParams(m.slice(m.indexOf('?') + 1)); return [i.origin + i.pathname, i.searchParams.get('template'), !!i.searchParams.get('title'), /^start: stopped/m.test(i.searchParams.get('report')), /fetching the core's worker script/.test(i.searchParams.get('report')), m.startsWith('mailto:flinner@nand.sh?'), /^PhiTeX: /.test(q.get('subject')), /^start: stopped/m.test(q.get('body')) || q.get('body').includes('clipboard'), /Nothing is sent until you send it/.test(r.textContent)]; })()

steps.what: Copy debug info, the engine failed: reached from the status text; the step and the error
has: ^  Starting the engine \(its page loaded, waiting for it to answer\) failed: the engine didn't start: fetching the core's worker script

steps.what: the status text says it stopped, as an error
steps.check: (() => { const b = document.getElementById('phitex-status'); return b.classList.contains('err') && b.textContent.startsWith("Couldn't start"); })()

steps.what: the core's worker failing as it starts: said, on the card
and the status text says the start stopped
the download refused: the step and the status
steps.check: document.querySelector('phitex-preview').shadowRoot.querySelector('#empty .card').textContent.includes('Downloading the project from Overleaf failed: project download failed: 500')

steps.what: the download cut off: the step, how far it got, and why
steps.check: /Downloading the project from Overleaf \(.* of .*\) failed: /.test(document.querySelector('phitex-preview').shadowRoot.querySelector('#empty .card').textContent)

steps.what: a download that never ends: how far it got, on the button's title (no card: it hasn't failed)
steps.check: /^PhiTeX diagnostics · Downloading the project from Overleaf… \(.* of .*\)$/.test(document.getElementById('phitex-logs').title) && !document.querySelector('phitex-preview').shadowRoot.querySelector('#empty:not([hidden]) .card')

steps.what: and the PDF downloaded says where the start is
steps.check: (() => { document.getElementById('phitex-status').click(); const t = document.querySelector('phitex-preview').shadowRoot.querySelector('#m-time .msg')?.textContent ?? ''; document.getElementById('phitex-status').click(); return t.startsWith('No PDF yet: no build has run. ⚡ Instant is at "Downloading the project from Overleaf…') || t; })()

steps.what: Copy debug info, the download stuck: the step and how far, as bytes
has: ^ +[0-9.]+ s Downloading the project from Overleaf… \([0-9.]+ [KM]B of [0-9.]+ [KM]B\)$

steps.what: Report this in the status's popover, the download stuck: drafts with the step, well formed
steps.check: (() => { const r = document.querySelector('phitex-preview').shadowRoot.querySelector('#m-time:not([hidden]) .phx-report'); if (!r) return 'no Report this'; const i = new URL(r.querySelector('a.phx-report-issue').href), m = r.querySelector('a.phx-report-mail').href; return [i.origin + i.pathname, /Downloading the project from Overleaf/.test(i.searchParams.get('report')), m.startsWith('mailto:flinner@nand.sh?subject=')]; })()

steps.what: no failure asked: the project opens, built
